## TRAVELER'S DIARRHEA
## Primary treatment
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Empiric antimicrobial treatment for non-bloody, severe acute diarrhea:
Preferred:
[Azithromycin 1000 mg PO one time dose [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-1gm-po-once)
< OR >
[Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 3 days [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-500mg-po-q24h)
Alternative:
[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 3 days [R,DI]](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Rifaximin 200 mg q8h for 3 days [M]](orz-set-abx-rifaxamin-200mg-po-q8h-for-3-days)
